mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can reduce glomerular filtration rate; ramipril's ACE inhibition may potentiate amikacin's renal injury through hemodynamic changes affecting glomerular perfusion pressure.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and amikacin levels closely; ensure adequate hydration and consider renal function assessment before and during therapy; use lowest effective amikacin dose and adjust for renal function.
